title: Remote Internships in 2027: How Rare They Are, What They Pay, and How to Spot a Fake
summary: Only 2.5% of the 76,130 internships open on Simplify are fully remote. Here's what they pay, which fields have them, and how to tell a real one from a scam.
body_markdown:
Live remote internship openings


6 open roles · checked November 18, 2026


- [Amgen Foundation · Undergrad Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/b1797f7b-33d0-43d2-82cb-ecce505aad7f/Undergrad-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-1) Remote, US · Summer 2027 · $28.87/hr


- [Amplify · Software Engineer Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/0e371048-09e7-4111-8768-bae91b1a2437/Software-Engineer-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-2) Remote, US · Summer 2027 · $30-$35/hr


- [Amplify · Product Management Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/d8ede2e6-c1f3-40fb-a435-9772d2aabf18/Product-Management-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-3) Remote, US · Summer 2027 · $30-$35/hr


- [Johnson & Johnson · Global Market Access Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/cc99b34f-6aca-4939-b26b-7bf65956de3b/Global-Market-Access-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-4) Fully remote, US · Summer 2027 · $34-$52/hr


- [Pinterest · UX Quantitative Research Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/eda40edd-acbe-4e9d-98b6-9591dea895bc/UX-Quantitative-Research-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-5) PhD · Remote, US or office · Summer 2027 · $11,000/month


- [Environmental Defense Fund · Consumer Energy Analytics Intern](https://simplify.jobs/p/4b853c05-5bdf-470c-a923-8b825bb0ac8a/Consumer-Energy-Analytics-Intern?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-6) Remote, US · Summer 2027 · $18-$20/hr


[See every live remote internship on Simplify →](https://simplify.jobs/jobs?type=Internship&travel_requirements=Remote&sort=updated&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=card-7)


Rarer than you'd think. Of the 76,130 internships open on Simplify right now, 1,887 are listed as fully remote. That's about 1 in 40. I'm a technical recruiter at Simplify, and the short version of this post is: remote internships exist, the good ones pay about the same as in-person ones, and the word "remote" is exactly what scammers put in a fake internship ad.


Below is what our data says about how many there are, what they pay and which fields have them, plus how to check that a remote internship is real before you hand anyone your bank details.


Two disclosures, since this is our own data. These numbers are a snapshot of internship listings open on Simplify on November 16, 2026, which Simplify finds on company career sites. And whether a listing counts as remote, hybrid or in person comes from Simplify reading each posting automatically, which isn't perfect. More on that below, because it matters for you too.


## How many internships are actually remote?


Here's how the 76,130 open internship listings on Simplify break down:


Work arrangement Open listings Share


Fully remote 1,887 2.5%


Hybrid 10,568 13.9%


In person 63,675 83.6%


Employers say much the same thing. In NACE's 2025 Internship & Co-op survey of 247 employers, 0.9% planned to run their 2024-25 internships fully virtual. Most (61.3%) planned a hybrid setup, and nearly 35% fully in person ([NACE, May 2025](https://www.naceweb.org/talent-acquisition/trends-and-predictions/internship-entry-level-job-modality-corresponds-with-students-job-preferences?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) ).


So if you only apply to fully remote roles, you're choosing from a very small pile. If remote matters because you can't relocate for the summer, hybrid roles near where you'll be living are worth a look too. There are more than five times as many of them.


1,887 remote internships are open on Simplify right now. See them all in one list, updated as new roles post.


[See all remote internships](https://simplify.jobs/jobs?type=Internship&travel_requirements=Remote&sort=updated&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=button-1)


## Do remote internships pay?


The ones posted by real companies usually do, and about as much as in-person internships.


For listings that state an hourly rate in US dollars, the median (using the middle of each listed range) is:


- Fully remote: $25 an hour (487 listings)
- Hybrid: $27 an hour (2,430 listings)
- In person: $25 an hour (14,259 listings)


Most listings don't state pay at all: 61% of remote ones and 59% of in-person ones. Missing pay on a posting is common and isn't a red flag by itself. Missing pay plus vague duties plus a Gmail address is a different story (see below).


What about unpaid? A for-profit company can only skip paying an intern if the internship passes the Department of Labor's "primary beneficiary test," which weighs seven factors, like whether the internship is tied to your coursework and whether your work replaces paid staff. Unpaid internships at nonprofits and government offices are generally allowed when you're volunteering ([DOL Fact Sheet #71](https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/fact-sheets/71-flsa-internships?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) ). From the hiring side, I'd say this: a company that can afford a remote team, laptops and software licenses can afford to pay its interns. If a for-profit company offers you a remote internship "for experience," ask why.


## Which fields have the most remote internships?


Creative and design work, by a wide margin. Among open internships that Simplify has tagged with a field, about 16% of creative and design roles (marketing content, social media, graphic and product design) are fully remote, against roughly 2% of technology and engineering roles and under 1% in healthcare and life sciences.


That tracks with the work. A social media or content role can be done from anywhere. A lab, a factory floor or a hospital can't, and many engineering teams still want interns close to their mentors.


Business and finance roles make up the largest group of remote internships by count, because there are so many of them overall, but the share that's remote is small (about 2%).


## "Remote" in a job title isn't always remote


When we compared each posting's work-arrangement label with what its location line actually says, about a third of listings labeled fully remote didn't mention remote in their location at all. Some of those are fine (the details are further down the description). Some aren't: when we spot-checked, one AI internship labeled remote in our data turned out to be hybrid in Sunnyvale on the company's own page.


It also goes the other way. Plenty of postings list an office city and "Remote, US" as one of several options. Pinterest's UX Quantitative Research internship, for example, lists "Remote / San Francisco / Seattle / New York."


Before you apply, read three things on the employer's own page:


1. **The location line.** "Remote, US," "United States - Remote," or "Fully remote" is what you want. "Hybrid" means you'll be expected in an office some days.
2. **Where you're allowed to work from.** Many remote internships are "US based applicants only," or only in "approved locations." Some are tied to one state. Remote doesn't mean anywhere in the world.
3. **Work authorization.** Most of the remote postings we checked ask that you be authorized to work in the US. If you need sponsorship, check this before you spend an hour on a cover letter.


## How to spot a fake remote internship


Remote roles are where most job scams live, because a fake company doesn't need an office. The FTC's warnings for job hunters all apply to internships ([FTC, job scams](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) ;[FTC, college students](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2025/05/college-students-avoid-scammers-while-you-job-hunt?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) ):


- **They ask you to pay.** For a starter kit, training, a certification or equipment from their "preferred vendor." The FTC puts it plainly: "Anyone who asks you to pay to get a job is a scammer."
- **They send you a check.** You deposit it, buy equipment or send part of the money on to someone, and the check bounces after your money's gone.
- **They reach you by text, WhatsApp or Telegram** , unasked, with an offer for a job you never applied to.
- **They want your Social Security number or bank details before there's a real offer.** Real employers collect these during onboarding, after you've signed something.
- **They hire you without talking to you.** A chat-only "interview" followed by an instant offer is a pattern, not a lucky break.


And from my side of the screen, here's what a real one looks like: a posting on the company's own careers site, a recruiter writing from the company's domain (not a free email address), at least one live conversation by video or phone, and an offer letter that names the pay, the dates and the person you'll report to. Boring, and that's the point.


If something feels off, look the company up yourself and contact it through its official website, not through the number or link in the message. You can report job scams to the FTC at[ReportFraud.ftc.gov](https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) .


## When to apply for remote internships


Now, for spring and summer. Right now on Simplify there are 120 open remote listings for Spring 2027 and 434 for Summer 2027. Big-company summer internships open in waves from late summer through spring, so more remote summer roles will keep appearing. Our[Summer 2027 internship timeline](https://simplify.jobs/blog/summer-2027-internship-timeline?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) has which companies tend to post in December and January.


With so few remote roles to go around, don't wait for a "perfect" one: apply soon after a role you like opens.


434 remote Summer 2027 internships are already open. Autofill your applications so you can get to them early.


[Get Simplify Copilot, free](https://simplify.jobs/copilot?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=button-2)


## Is a remote internship worth it?


It can be, especially if the alternative is no internship at all, or one you can't afford to relocate for. But go in knowing the trade-off. In NACE's survey, employers with in-person internships extended full-time offers to 72% of their 2024 interns on average, compared with about 56% for internships that mixed remote and in-person work ([NACE, August 2025](https://www.naceweb.org/talent-acquisition/internships/intern-offer-and-conversion-rates-fall-acceptances-rise?ref=blog.simplify.jobs) ). That's a comparison between different employers and programs, not proof that working remotely costs you the offer. But the gap is a reason to be deliberate about being visible: ask for regular one-on-ones, turn your camera on, and share your work in progress instead of only the finished version.


If you're casting a wide net, you can filter for remote roles on Simplify's[remote internship list](https://simplify.jobs/jobs?type=Internship&travel_requirements=Remote&sort=updated&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=body-1) , which updates as new ones open, and keep track of where you've applied with the[job tracker](https://simplify.jobs/tracker?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=body-2) .


Applying to a few dozen of the 1,887? Keep every application, deadline and interview in one place.


[Get the free Job Tracker](https://simplify.jobs/job-application-tracker?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=remote-internships&utm_content=button-3)


## Common questions


**Are remote internships paid?** Most remote internships at companies are. On Simplify, the median listed pay for open fully remote internships is $25 an hour (487 listings that state an hourly rate), the same as in-person internships. Unpaid internships at for-profit companies have to pass the Department of Labor's primary beneficiary test.


**How many internships are remote?** Few. Of 76,130 internships open on Simplify on November 16, 2026, 1,887 (2.5%) were listed as fully remote and 10,568 (13.9%) as hybrid.


**Are there remote internships for Summer 2027?** Yes. On November 16, 2026, Simplify had 434 open remote internship listings for Summer 2027 and 120 for Spring 2027, including roles at Amgen, Amplify, Johnson & Johnson and Pinterest. More summer roles will open through the spring.


**How can I tell if a remote internship is a scam?** Be suspicious if you're asked to pay for anything, deposit a check and send money on, share your Social Security number or bank details before a real offer, or if you're "hired" over text or chat without a live interview. Contact the company through its official website to confirm, and report scams at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.


**Can I do a remote internship from outside the US?** Usually not for US companies. Many remote internship postings say "US based applicants only" or limit where you can work from, and most require US work authorization. Check the location and eligibility lines on the employer's page before you apply.
